targets.expr: sum by(status, exported_endpoint) (increase(ml_api_requests_total{namespace="ml-api"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (pod) (backend_api_db_connections_active{namespace="backend-api", job="backend-api", container="backend-api"})

panels.description: Database queries issued by backend-api per interval, by outcome (backend_api_db_queries_total). Anything other than "success" is a failed query.
panels.title: backend-api database queries by status

targets.expr:
max by (namespace, pod) (
    (kube_pod_container_status_ready == bool 0) == 1
      unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Succeeded"} == 1)
      unless on (namespace, pod) kube_pod_deletion_timestamp
      unless on (namespace, pod) (time() - kube_pod_start_time < 60)
  or
    (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__rate_interval]) > bool 0) == 1
)
count by (namespace) (time() - kube_pod_created < 300)

panels.title: pods created in the last 5 min

panels.description: Pods that have been in the Pending phase for more than 60 seconds: not yet scheduled to a node (for example requesting more CPU or memory than is available), or scheduled but unable to start their containers (for example an image that cannot be pulled). Empty when everything is running.

targets.expr:
max by (namespace, pod) (
  (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"} == 1)
  and on (namespace, pod) (time() - kube_pod_created > 60)
)

panels.title: pending pods

panels.description: Why a pod is failing, one row per pod and reason: containers that cannot start (CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ...), containers that were killed and restarted (OOMKilled, Error) and pods that cannot be scheduled (Unschedulable). Pods that are running but fail their readiness probe have no reason here; they only appear in "unhealthy pods".

targets.expr:
max by (namespace, pod, reason) (
  kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason!~"ContainerCreating|PodInitializing"} == 1
)
or
max by (namespace, pod, reason) (
  (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason == 1)
  and on (namespace, pod, container)
  (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__rate_interval]) > 0)
)
or
label_replace(
  max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1),
  "reason", "Unschedulable", "", ""
)

panels.title: pod failure reasons

panels.description: Share of CPU scheduling periods in which the pod was throttled by its CPU limit. 0% means the limit is never hit; sustained values above roughly 25% usually show up as higher request latency.
panels.title: CPU throttling per pod

targets.expr: sum by (datname, state) (pg_stat_activity_count{datname="voize"})

panels.description: All open connections to the postgres server as a share of max_connections. At 100% new connections are refused.

targets.expr:
sum(pg_stat_activity_count{namespace="postgres"})
/
max(pg_settings_max_connections{namespace="postgres"})

panels.title: postgres connection limit usage

panels.description: Age of the oldest open transaction in the voize database, for running queries (active) and for sessions holding a transaction open without doing anything (idle in transaction). A steadily climbing line means a query is hanging or blocked.
panels.title: voize longest running transaction

panels.description: Locks currently held or awaited in the voize database, by lock mode. A few accesssharelock entries are normal; accessexclusivelock blocks every other query on the table.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (pg_locks_count{namespace="postgres", datname="voize"}) > 0

panels.title: voize database locks by mode
